# vscode-copilot-config

Professional GitHub Copilot agent and instruction configurations for software development teams.

## Structure

```
.github/
├── agents/          # Specialized AI agents (architects, developers, reviewers)
├── instructions/    # Framework-specific coding guidelines and standards
├── prompts/         # Reusable prompt templates
└── skills/          # Domain-specific knowledge bases
```

## Usage

Copy the `.github` folder to your project root. Configurations are automatically available via GitHub Copilot in VS Code.

## Requirements

- VS Code with GitHub Copilot extension
